meta.name: Boo
meta.description: Two friends are trying to get over their friend who has just passed away, one of them is just trying to get through life, and the other, well, she is convinced that her friend is a ghost haunting them. while that's happening, the friend who's passed away is trying to scare her friends/ loved ones to be able to get a scare ticket, which is "her pass to everlasting sunshine and rainbows" while she gets help from another ghost whose voice sounds like he's 200 years old!, Watch to find out what happens!!!!
meta.slogan: Will she be able to get her scare ticket?
